question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Careful
solution:
The correct answer is: **Cautious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Careful"** means to avoid potential problems or dangers. (सावधान)

 
 
• **Example:** She was very cautious when crossing the busy street.
 
 
 
• **"Cautious"** refers to someone who is careful and avoids risks. (सावधान)
 
 
• **Example:** He is a cautious driver who always follows the speed limit.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Corrupt** (भ्रष्ट): Willing to act dishonestly in return for money or personal gain.

 
 
• **Example:** The corrupt official was removed from office.
 
 
 
• **Captivating** (मोहक): Capable of attracting and holding interest; charming.
 
 
• **Example:** Her captivating smile won everyone's heart.
 
 
 
• **Corrosive** (संक्षारक): Tending to cause corrosion, damaging.
 
 
• **Example:** The corrosive chemicals can cause serious burns.
